comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
from "nforum.ogplanet.com/uwo/forum_posts.asp?TID=636007"

Search - +EXP gained when finding a discovery with search, doing so relieves some fatigue

Recognition - +EXP gained when finding a discovery with search, doing so relieves some fatigue

Unlock - Additional treasure from treasure chests in dungeons

Ecological Research - +EXP gained when finding a discovery with search, doing so relieves some fatigue

"X" Trade (all of them) - Enables an "X Order" skill that costs 100 vigor and which purchases 10% of a normal PO amount each time it is activated. Can be used repatedly without port resetting, allowing purchase of unlimited trade goods so long as the player has vigor and cargo space.

Swordplay - Reduce the vigor cost of Assault/Gunfire/Tactics/Guard

Tactics and Guard - Reduces enemy vigor when used

Assault and Gunfire - Cancels enemy items used when you use Assault/Gunfire

Gunnery - Reduce vigor cost of Accuracy/Ballistics/Penetration/Reloading by a few points

Firefighting - Free automatic use of Repair skill when you successfully firefight.

more skills will be available in future updates. See the same post in forum :)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Some more unlisted Search boosting equipment:

Clothing/Armor Slot:
Shirt and Denim Pants (Red) -- +2 Search, +1 Appraisal, unisex, 6k fame to equip.
Obtained: San Francisco, at the Gold Nugget Appraiser; it costs 18k Large Golden Nugget points per outfit, and the Appraiser's selection changes weekly, so it isn't always available.

Baji Jeogori (Green) -- +2 Search, +1 Collection, unisex, 20k fame to equip.
Obtained: Songsunri Ruins dungeon; lower floor hidden passage (the one that has rock-hewn walls and has its treasure chests spread out at a distance) treasure chest. Somewhat rare.

Special Ropa/Falda (color custom) -- +2 Search, Recognition, Navigation. Ropa is Male-only, Falda is Female-only. 500 fame to equip.
Obtained: These outfits were only available from the Age of Revolution Premium Bottle released on 5/1/2017. Your fellow UWO players are the only way to get them now.

Head Slot:
Fedora Hat (brown/white/pink) -- +1 Search, unisex, 8k fame to equip.
Obtained: Sewing R12 recipe from the MA reward recipe book, "North America Pioneer Clothes Sewing Book V.1."; the recipe itself calls for Cotton Fabric x15, Leather cords x10, and Suede x5.

The recipe book is a bit hard to get since it involves plundering for most of the MA items, and an Aide with Sewing +1 to create one of the MA items as well.

Hand Slot:
Western Gloves -- +1 Search, +1 Throwing. Unisex, 6k fame to equip.
Obtained: Plundered from Poacher Lv31 enemies found at Tacoma Outskirts, and North America West Coast. It can be obtained even without Plunder skill, but it could take a little longer.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I inquired via support ticket whether or not having a high Search skill rank is of any importance when mining for gold or gemstones. The response I received was: "having a higher ranked search skill will always be beneficial when utilizing the skill in the above scenarios."

Likewise, I asked about the colors on the Surveying map during mining, and was told: "The colours depict the amount of gold nuggets that reside in those areas. Generally, the amount of nuggets decreases based on this hierarchy:
Red > Green > Yellow > Blue > Grey
These colours can shift over time so it's a good idea to keep an eye on your survey map."

Good to know. If the gold/gemstone mining guide still exists out there, somebody can add that information to it if it's missing. And if it wasn't, apologies for sharing old data.

Lastly, [CA]Huseyin_Gazi informs me that this archive map is great for grinding Search/Unlock/Archaeology skills: Map of Roman History Book

Cheers, and great search skill spamming to you.

As I understand it, the most important element for locating Large Gold Nuggets (and in Africa, Large Gemstones) is the color of your digging map. In order of worst to best:

Having a high search rank does help, but all adventure skills cap at r20. Best of luck to you! Cheers.

Tip: it is possible to complete quests and archive maps requiring the use of this skill if you are 1-2 levels below the quest or map's listed skill requirement. However, it usually takes longer to successfully locate the discovery as a result.

Additionally, it is possible to leech this skill to complete quest/map discoveries while in fleet with others (but you must share the quest and have all quest clues OR be holding an archive map at the time when your fleetmate makes the same discovery).
